description: Cart total is wrong after changing quantity with a coupon applied

issue.title: Cart total is wrong after changing quantity with a coupon applied
issue.body:
On the shop page:
1. Click "Add to cart" on Headphones ($50.00)
2. Change the quantity to 3
3. Enter coupon SAVE20 and click Apply. The total is $120.00, which is correct.
4. Change the quantity back to 1

Expected: the total is $40.00 (20% off $50.00)
Actual: the total shows $20.00
issue.author: samvit-srivastava
